I'm planning a session with my gf for this weekend, and we're looking for some rope so we can have bondagey fun.

The rope at sex stores looks kind of overpriced. Can I purchase from places like home depot, what kind of rope am I looking for if I buy from there? How many yards should I buy?

Depending on what style of rope play you're looking to do, you want anywhere from 20 to 50ft. My go-to is a 40ft purple silk rope.

In terms of acquiring it, Amazon is definitely the way to go It is always good to support your local shops, but honestly, the markup for rope is a little obscene.

Material is another important factor to consider. Silk rope is very strong and surprisingly soft; it doesn't feel like clothing silk at all. It is a mainstay for my partners and I. For those of a more masochistic bend, hemp rope can be very abrasive and is cheap as dirt. Cotton rope is a bit of a middleground between the two.

For buying your own rope from a hardware store, I would also bare in mind thickness; too thin and it may dig in uncomfortably, too thick and it becomes difficult to manipulate. I like a diameter a little thinner than my pinky finger, but I have large hands, so I'd say go with her, tie some simple knots around her wrist and just test to see what she likes.

I was in home depot and i noticed the hardware department is stocking 3/8 and half inch diameter nylon dock line( marine rope for boat tie lines). It's not too thick, but it is fairly heavy and solid. Would that be okay? It's 54 cents a foot, so i'm considering picking up 10 feet to give it a shot.

 

here is the exact rope in the aisle.

Yeah, that rope would work fine, though it might be a bit thick. You can make some really nice large decorative knots with something like that. Is it relatively rigid? You want to be able to tie a square knot with it what has no holes without pulling too tightly.

For anything shibari like you need more than 10 feet. Remember the rule of thumb that if she say's "tighter" this means more loops please. A simple pair of cuffs will easily use 20 ft of rope for a beginner like you or me. Also if possible practice your ties.
